description: Stop one of your DCA schedules and get the UNSPENT remainder of the budget back; what the schedule already bought is already in your wallet. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY; only the owner can close. The refund lands in the account pinned at open (recreated first if it was closed); a schedule funded with native COOK is refunded as COOK, a wCOOK-funded one is unwrapped in the same tx unless `unwrapCook: false`. A schedule that has spent its whole budget closes itself and refunds its rent, so it will no longer be listed. The built transaction is decoded and checked (your schedule, refund to you, known programs only) and simulated before signing.

unwrapCook.description: default true. false = leave a wCOOK refund wrapped in the token account

unwrapSol.description: DEPRECATED alias of `unwrapCook` — same flag, kept for older callers

name: close_dca
title: Close a DCA schedule
